name: focus-timer
description: A Pomodoro timer in the status line with focus and break cycles.

focusMinutes.title: Focus minutes
focusMinutes.description: Length of a focus round when /pomodoro is run without a number.

breakMinutes.title: Break minutes
breakMinutes.description: Length of the break that follows a focus round. 0 skips breaks.

longBreakMinutes.title: Long break minutes
longBreakMinutes.description: Length of the break after every fourth focus round.

sound.title: Ring a bell
sound.description: Play a short bell when a round or a break ends (macOS plays it; other systems stay silent).
